faq.question: Can I change my plan later?
faq.answer: Yes! You can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Changes take effect immediately, and we'll prorate any charges.

faq.question: What happens when I exceed my quota?
faq.answer: When you reach 100% of your quota, features will be disabled until the next billing cycle or you upgrade your plan. We'll notify you at 80% usage.

faq.question: Do you offer refunds?
faq.answer: We offer a 14-day money-back guarantee for all paid plans. No questions asked.

faq.question: How does native WhatsApp vs Twilio work for messaging?
faq.answer: WhatsApp (Pro plan) is perfect for small-scale WhatsApp integration. Twilio (Team plan) provides enterprise-grade reliability and compliance for larger teams.

faq.question: Can I use external video links with the free plan?
faq.answer: Yes! The free plan supports external video links from Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams. Smart Video Rooms with built-in recording/transcription require Pro or higher.

commercial.title: Commercial terms
commercial.paymentTermsText: The Founders Basic plan is offered as a one-time payment of €29. Pro and Team are offered as monthly subscriptions at the price shown before you confirm payment.
commercial.refundsText: You may request a refund within 14 days of purchase, unless applicable law provides a longer period. Requests are handled through a support ticket.
commercial.cancellationText: You can cancel a monthly subscription at any time. Cancellation prevents future renewals and access remains available until the end of the paid period. The one-time payment does not renew automatically.
commercial.limitsText: Each plan has the user, page, customer, automation and other limits shown on the pricing page. We will notify you as you approach a quota.
commercial.supportText: The official support channel is the ticket system inside Anytimebot. Response times may vary by plan and request priority.
